description: This file implements the core functions for a pointer array component object in C, including creation, removal, object enrollment, and initialization functions. It is part of a larger system for managing array objects with operation functions, and includes licensing and copyright information.

classes.name: ANSC_PTR_ARRAY_OBJECT
classes.description: A structure representing the pointer array object with associated method pointers and member variables.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscPtrArrayCOCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Constructs and initializes a new pointer array object, setting up function pointers and basic properties.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscPtrArrayCORemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Destroys the pointer array object and releases allocated memory.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscPtrArrayCOEnrollObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Enrolls any required objects in the pointer array object.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscPtrArrayCOInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the member variables and function pointers of the pointer array object, including base class initialization.
